from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re,subprocess,sys
root=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
from verify_current_scientific_premises import validate_startup_surface
p=root/'udt_machian_global_clock_feasibility_2026-09-28'
scope={'LIVE.md','HANDOFF.md','CURRENT_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md','MEMORY.md','INDEX.md','UDT_RESEARCH_ROADMAP.md'}
launch=json.loads((p/'LAUNCH.json').read_text())
def git(*a):
 return subprocess.check_output(['git','-c','core.preloadIndex=false','-c','index.threads=1',*a],text=True)
def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert git('branch','--show-current').strip()=='grok'
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD').strip()==launch['head']==git('rev-parse','origin/grok').strip()
assert not git('diff','--cached','--name-only').strip()
assert set(git('diff','--name-only').splitlines())==scope
pins=dict(launch['source_pins'])
for name in ['ADDITIONAL_SOURCE_PINS.json','LATE_SOURCE_PINS.json']:pins.update(json.loads((p/name).read_text()))
for name,h in pins.items():
 if name not in scope:assert sha(root/name)==h,name
for name,h in json.loads((p/'CANDIDATE_FREEZE.json').read_text())['sha256'].items():assert sha(p/name)==h,name
for seal in ['review/SOURCE_FIRST_SEAL.json','review/DIRECT_PREEXPOSURE_SEAL.json','review/DIRECT_REVIEW_SEAL.json']:
 for name,h in json.loads((p/seal).read_text())['sha256'].items():assert sha(root/name)==h,(seal,name)
old=git('show',launch['head']+':CURRENT_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md');new=(root/'CURRENT_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md').read_text()
assert old.split('## Current next gate\n')[0]==new.split('## Current next gate\n')[0]
assert old.split('## Architecture\n')[1]==new.split('## Architecture\n')[1]
oldroad=git('show',launch['head']+':UDT_RESEARCH_ROADMAP.md');newroad=(root/'UDT_RESEARCH_ROADMAP.md').read_text()
oldquotes=[s for s in oldroad.splitlines() if s.startswith('>')];newquotes=[s for s in newroad.splitlines() if s.startswith('>')]
assert all(q in newquotes for q in oldquotes)
assert len(newquotes)==len(oldquotes)+1
for left,right in [('## Accepted calibration inputs','## Direction for the next bounded question'),('## Data-guided discovery','## Other branches and reusable work')]:
 assert oldroad[oldroad.index(left):oldroad.index(right)]==newroad[newroad.index(left):newroad.index(right)]
prior=[n for n in git('ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard').splitlines() if not n.startswith(p.name+'/')]
assert sorted(prior)==sorted(launch['prior_untracked_paths'])
audit=json.loads((p/'checks/premise_audit.json').read_text())
assert audit['returncode']==0 and not audit['timeout']
assert 'PASS: 406-row premise registry' in (p/'checks/premise_audit.stdout').read_text()
assert not (p/'checks/premise_audit.stderr').read_text()
links=0
for doc in [root/n for n in scope]+list(p.glob('*.md')):
 for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]\n]+\]\(([^)]+)\)',doc.read_text()):
  if '://' in target:continue
  path,sep,anchor=target.partition('#');dest=doc.parent/path if path else doc
  assert dest.exists(),(str(doc),target)
  if anchor:
   heads=re.findall(r'^#+\s+(.+?)\s*$',dest.read_text(),re.M)
   slugs={re.sub(r'[^\w\- ]','',h.lower()).replace(' ','-') for h in heads}
   assert anchor in slugs,(str(doc),target)
  links+=1
validate_startup_surface(root)
git('diff','--check')
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','scope':'startup regression, source/freeze and document correspondence; not scientific proof','head':launch['head'],'unchanged_source_pins':len(set(pins)-scope),'frozen_candidate_entries':8,'review_seals_checked':3,'maintained_pointers':6,'prior_untracked_names':len(prior),'protected_payload_contents':'not read or certified','founding_opening_and_program_architecture':'byte-preserved','prior_owner_quotes_and_core_direction_sections':'preserved','local_links_checked':links,'full_premise_audit':'exit0/406 rows; original receipt inspected, no repeat','startup_guard':'PASS after pointer edits','pointer_sha256':{n:sha(root/n) for n in sorted(scope)}},indent=2))
